
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /animations  (/anim)                       │
  │  Animation Level                            │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Set the animation level (full, subtle, off).

  Usage:
    /animations
    /animations <level>

  Details:
    Controls spinners and boot animations:
    
      • full   — Animated spinners and boot sequence
      • subtle — Static indicators, no motion
      • off    — Plain text only

  Examples:
    $ /animations
    $ /anim off

  Related: /theme  /font
